title: Gate Rust CCP2 production feature combinations
description:
Scope: Rust CCP2 jobs in /home/mark/Developer/lichen-workspace/project-LICHEN/.github/workflows/interop.yml, using production consumers/integration tests in /home/mark/Developer/lichen-workspace/project-LICHEN/rust/lichen-core/, lichen-node and lichen-gateway within the same Rust workspace. Execute the applicable production feature matrix and no-default-feature/no_std checks against the frozen independent corpus, recording actual commands and revisions. Reuse established dependency/source setup; do not change OSCORE internals, fork/source policy or unrelated feature policy.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Use a focused extension of existing CI jobs rather than a new build framework. This job depends on rust.14 and vectors.13 and remains parallel with other language jobs.
acceptance_criteria: Relevant cargo tests, supported feature/no-default-feature checks, fmt and clippy run successfully on the declared toolchain, with required CCP2 cases collected and reported. An absent integration binary, disabled required feature, missing case or failing independent byte/state expectation cannot yield success. Result artifacts identify source, corpus, package/features and commands. Compile-only checks are not labeled runtime or RF conformance.
